description: Score how ready a website's home page is to be read and quoted by AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews: citability, brand and entity consistency, structure, AI crawler access and supporting media. It measures readiness, not whether AI assistants actually cite the site. No KinetixSEO account needed. A site checked in the last 24 hours gets that stored result. Free: spends no credits.

url.description: The website to check: a domain (example.com) or any URL on it. The home page of that domain is checked.

name: check_ai_search_readiness
title: Check AI search readiness
